## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix fingerprint preservation before merge: refreshing an edited tracked file currently makes verification accept the edit.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register new files, with tests covering both helpers. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve fingerprints for already tracked files — If an edited tracked file is included in `names`, refreshing replaces its recorded digest and makes `verify()` return true. The unconditional assignment defeats the pull-request description’s stated behavior that existing fingerprints detect hand edits. — Refreshing after adding files can silently legitimize changes to tracked content, preventing users from detecting those edits through integrity verification.
